protocol: Train-only scratch C++ candidates against frozen exact current baseline; permitted inputs in SQLite receipt order. GNSS only evaluator. Whole vehicle/date sessions; per-bag common output stamps and common GNSS masks. Table for30618, physics for30639. Matched 1/3/5-second paired-wheel blackout endpoints from identical 5.12-second deletions. No timestamp shifts. Public bags only post-freeze diagnostics.

freeze.json.selection: Train 30618 sample-weighted nominal RMSE among candidates improving both complete 30618 session nominal and every 1/3/5s blackout speed RMSE. 30639 compatibility improves too. No validation/public/holdout scores examined.

freeze_stale.json.selection: Single hypothesis predeclared before train evaluation: only both stale by existing 0.35s threshold; smoothing and fade use same threshold; no sweep. All complete train sessions improve dropout1/3/5speedRMSE. Healthy behavior retained. Public data not evaluated for this candidate before freezing.

public.protocol: post-freeze diagnostic; original timestamps, nearest fused signed-x reference within 50ms; common mask; no parameter choice

public_stale.protocol: post-freeze diagnostic; original timestamps, nearest fused signed-x reference within 50ms; common mask; no parameter choice

synthetic.protocol: Independent analytic ground truth; fixed faults; 20 Hz commands, 10 Hz wheels delayed 40 ms with deterministic noise/jitter; 5 s warmup. Fault timestamps are measurement time. Same input bytes and exact common output times for both versions.

synthetic_stale.protocol: Independent analytic ground truth; fixed faults; 20 Hz commands, 10 Hz wheels delayed 40 ms with deterministic noise/jitter; 5 s warmup. Fault timestamps are measurement time. Same input bytes and exact common output times for both versions.
